fi_aa.title: Asset Accounting
fi_aa.risk: Depreciation areas, currencies, fiscal years and transfer dates must be agreed. ANLC values are fiscal-year accumulations, not a ready-made posting file. Asset balances must not also enter the general ledger opening balance. Asset transaction history is reconciliation reference data; Universal Parallel Accounting requires a separate supported interface assessment.

mm.title: Materials Management
mm.risk: Stock is a frozen, reconciled inventory population, including batch and special stock. MARD quantities alone do not establish complete inventory. Physical inventory, valuation, units and currency conversion need business sign-off. Historical goods movements are reference data. Open purchasing scope requires item status, receipts, invoices, deletion, returns and remaining quantities; it is not inferred from the header alone.

qm.title: Quality Management
qm.risk: Lots, results and usage decisions have process and status prerequisites. Results are reference data until a supported transfer interface is selected. Inspection plans require task-list effectivity, selected operations, characteristics, sampling and material assignments; plain PLKO rows are not an effective plan. Notifications require catalogs, partners and status decisions.

ps.title: Project System
ps.risk: Retain both external project/WBS identifiers and internal references. Rebuild hierarchy with target key maps; do not copy internal object numbers. Project costs are reference history. Status, networks, settlement rules, budgets, commitments and investment measures require a supported business interface and separate scope agreement.

pp.title: Production Planning
pp.risk: BOMs and routings need key date, engineering change, usage, alternative and selected-node resolution. Preserve alternative sequences and dependencies. Production orders are process references unless the chosen target interface explicitly supports their state; confirmations, goods movements and costs must not be reposted as master data.

co.title: Controlling
co.risk: Resolve time intervals at cutover and map controlling areas, cost centers, profit centers and order numbers. Cost elements integrate with S/4HANA G/L accounts. COEP is source history, not a target Universal Journal posting template. Plan data, allocations, settlement and commitments require additional interface scope.

fi.title: Financial Accounting
fi.risk: Customers and suppliers require Business Partner/CVI mapping, roles and numbering. FI BSEG may be a cluster table in ECC and therefore cannot be assumed readable by CDS; use the full-row ABAP helper or a verified extraction interface when necessary. Open-at-cutover means posted by cutover and not cleared by cutover, including subsequently cleared items. Separate currencies, debit/credit signs, ledgers and fiscal periods; prevent double-counting subledger openings in G/L balances.

sd.title: Sales and Distribution
sd.risk: Open sales scope must resolve item rejection, delivery and billing status, document flow and remaining quantities. Historical deliveries and billing documents are reference data; recreating them can trigger accounting or logistics. Partners, pricing, texts and tax need explicit target interfaces and agreed key maps. Do not infer open status from VBAK alone.
